name: Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator
author: THE BELOV

sections.description:
For financial advisors and real estate professionals: the most effective loan & mortgage calculator plugin for WordPress!

Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator by Belov is a plugin and a marketing tool that helps you engage visitors on finance, real estate, and banking websites.

This plugin turns your WordPress site into a helpful resource for anyone researching loans and mortgages. Whether you run a financial advisory blog, a real estate agency website, or a banking portal, the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator will keep your visitors coming back.

Having a loan calculator on your website is an absolute must if your business is in finance, real estate, or lending. Your visitors will love the opportunity to estimate monthly payments, compare loan scenarios, and review amortization schedules right on your site. Make your service stand out and get more leads!

SAVE TIME LIKE NEVER BEFORE

Numerous factors influence financial commitments — loan amount, interest rate, term length, down payment, and payment frequency. No one wants to waste time on these tedious calculations!

Allow your visitors to delegate this complex task to the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator. Install it and transform your site into a magnet for people interested in smart financial planning.

FINANCIAL SCIENCE BEHIND THE CALCULATOR

Our calculator uses advanced financial analysis techniques to accurately calculate payments and the total cost of a loan.

The plugin supports over 170 global currencies and offers flexible payment frequency options: annually, semi-annually, quarterly, monthly (default), bi-weekly, or weekly. It calculates an accurate payment schedule considering the selected payment frequency and currency.

HOW IT WORKS

Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator gives you a shortcode to place on any page, post, or widget. Put it where it catches the most attention!

Loan balance, interest rate, down payment: the calculator covers everything

Once installed, you get an intuitive settings panel in your WordPress admin area. Configure the currency, input fields, interest rate, down payment, payment frequency, and styling — all in one place. Generate your shortcode and paste it anywhere on your site.

Real-time amortization schedules

The calculator generates a detailed amortization table showing principal vs. interest for each payment period. Your visitors can see exactly how their loan is paid off over time — a feature that financial advisors and real estate agents value most.

Increasing screentime

A loan calculator is one of the most engaging features you can offer on a financial website. Visitors can’t resist checking monthly payments for different loan amounts, comparing interest rates, and exploring amortization schedules. Keep them on your site longer!

Handy & user-friendly

The calculator displays results instantly as users input data — no extra buttons to click. Monthly payment, total interest, total cost, and full amortization schedules are presented in an intuitive layout that visitors love.

BOOST YOUR FINANCE & REAL ESTATE WEBSITE

Running a WordPress site for loan seekers, homebuyers, or financial clients? Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator by Belov is the easiest way to capture attention and personalize the experience.

Interactive tools hold attention like nothing else! Your site visitors will spend more time engaging with the calculator and will be much more likely to convert into clients or subscribers.

Personalize user experience for your visitors and grow your finance platform!

Read more on the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator website.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Styling

The plugin lets you change interface colors to match your website’s design. Use the built-in color picker to adjust the primary and secondary colors. The Pro version provides even more flexibility with advanced color schemes, custom layouts, and complete design control.

Instant results or email delivery

You can choose how results are presented — directly on the form or via email. To make this even easier, we’ve integrated with Mailchimp, HubSpot, Kit (ConvertKit), Zapier, and Make in the Pro version.

Responsive on all devices

The calculator is fully optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop. Your visitors get a seamless experience regardless of their device — no pinching, zooming, or horizontal scrolling.

PRO EDITION

Advanced features, email marketing integrations, and a powerful admin dashboard: make the most of Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator!

Unlimited calculators

Create as many calculator instances as you need — different pages, different settings, different styles. Perfect for multi-service financial websites.

PDF results & email templates

Let your visitors download their loan calculation results as a beautifully formatted PDF or receive them via email. Customize the templates with your branding, logo, and message.

Optimize your marketing

The Pro version has excellent integrations with popular marketing services:

  • Mailchimp
    Collect emails, build your subscriber list, and run targeted campaigns.

  • HubSpot
    Sync contacts and nurture leads with automated marketing workflows.

  • Kit (ConvertKit)
    Grow your email list with seamless creator-focused integration.

  • Zapier & Make
    Connect to 5,000+ apps and automate your business processes.

More integrations are coming soon!

Other Pro features

Improve user experience with a fully enhanced toolkit:

  • Custom labels & translations for every field
  • Advanced color schemes and layouts
  • Google reCAPTCHA integration
  • CSV export for data analysis
  • Entries management dashboard
  • Priority support

And much more to elevate your website.

WHO IS THIS PLUGIN FOR?

  • Financial Advisory Websites — Provide valuable loan and mortgage calculation tools
  • Real Estate Agencies — Help homebuyers estimate monthly mortgage payments
  • Banking & Lending Portals — Offer clients accurate loan estimates instantly
  • Accounting & Tax Firms — Support clients with financial planning calculations
  • Personal Finance Blogs — Enhance your content with interactive finance features

Try Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator today and give your visitors a truly helpful financial planning tool!

TRANSLATIONS

  • English: default, always included.

Note: The plugin is localized/translateable by default. For translating we recommend the awesome plugin Loco Translate.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen, or upload the files to /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-loan-mortgage-calculator.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Loan & Mortgage in your wp-admin menu and configure the calculator settings.
  4. Copy the shortcode [ultimate_loan_mortgage_calculator] and place it on any page, post, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I add the calculator to my page?

Go to Loan & Mortgage in your admin menu, configure your settings, then copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget.

Can I customize the colors of the calculator?

Yes! Use the built-in color picker in the plugin settings to match your website’s design. The Pro version offers even more styling options.

Does the plugin support different currencies?

Yes, you can select from over 170 global currencies in the plugin settings to suit your needs.

What payment frequencies are available?

The calculator supports annually, semi-annually, quarterly, monthly, bi-weekly, and weekly payment frequencies. Monthly is the default.

Is it possible to set default values for the calculator?

Absolutely! You can set default values for Loan Balance, Interest Rate, and Down Payment in the plugin settings.

Can users get the results via email?

Yes, users can request detailed loan results sent directly to their email address. The Pro version adds full email template customization.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The calculator is fully responsive and optimized for all screen sizes.

Is there a PRO version available?

Yes! The PRO version includes unlimited calculators, PDF reports, email templates, marketing integrations (Mailchimp, HubSpot, Kit, Zapier, Make), custom labels, and much more. Learn more at wploanmortgage.com.

How do I get support?

You can ask your question on the WordPress support forum or contact us through our website.
